// rok_about : 'A short plume under voxels in a marker colour'
// xs_begin
// author : 'Rok test'
// xs_end

// The cell right below a voxel of the current colour gets the colour after
// it, the cell below that the same. The marker voxels stay.
float map(vec3 v) {
  float index = voxel(v);
  if (index > 0.0) return index;
  if (voxel(v + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)) == i_color_index) return i_color_index + 1.0;
  if (voxel(v + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 2.0)) == i_color_index) return i_color_index + 1.0;
  return 0.0;
}
